_comment: Packaging options passed to x9/tools/boot-xnu.py, taken from pan220 build.sh. root_manifest comes from local.json (device data, never committed).
_comment_defaults: X9 kernel feature switches proven on the device are default-on in the kernel (sweet_x9_arg in pe_serial.c); pass name=0 to turn one off. UFS defaults to the device-qualified G5 ceiling (ug=5), with DVFSRC INIT-only by default while ug=4/5 is enabled; ug=0 disables late scaling, and explicit x9_dvfsrc/dv settings override the dependency default. No ug/dv tokens are needed here. x9_metal_render=1 stays because the X9GeneralMetal plugin reads it from kern.bootargs.
